commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<none>} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-<none>}"; git status --porcelain | head; echo "---base---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main

SHA=adfcaebf7f1296b3d5c6102c4b2387b8cfbabc97
echo "=== Move 2a / Move 3 in shipped skills/ + .prflow ext (HEAD tree) ==="
for f in $(git ls-tree -r --name-only $SHA -- skills/ .prflow/prompt-extensions/ 2>/dev/null); do
  git show $SHA:"$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -Hn --label="$f" 'Move 2a\|Move 3' 
done
echo "=== done skills ==="

for f in skills/create-issue/references/issue-template.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-regression.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-contracts.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-semantic.md skills/create-issue/references/step-3-5-steelman.md skills/create-issue/references/degradation-routing.md skills/create-issue/SKILL.md; do
  echo "### $f"
  git show adfcaebf7f1296b3d5c6102c4b2387b8cfbabc97:"$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -n 'Move 2a\|Move 3\|three moves\|Mov …[per-command-truncated]

for p in issue-template quality-group-semantic quality-group-regression quality-group-contracts quality-group-premises quality-group-compatibility step-3-5-steelman; do
  echo "### $p"
done 2>/dev/null
echo "--- semantic head ---"; git show adfcaebf7f1296b3d5c6102c4b2387b8cfbabc97:skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-semantic.md | grep -n 'reproducible verification\|verification checklist'
echo "--- premises head ---"; git show adfcaebf7f1296b3d5c6102c4b2387b8cfbabc97:skills/create-issue …[per-command-truncated]

for f in skills/create-issue/references/issue-template.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-semantic.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-regression.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show adfcaebf7f1296b3d5c6102c4b2387b8cfbabc97:$f | grep -n "reproducible verification\|manual checklist\|residual-risk\|Move 2a\|Move 3\|reproducible stand-in\|stand-in"; done

for f in skills/create-issue/references/issue-template.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-regression.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-semantic.md skills/create-issue/references/quality-group-contracts.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; git show adfcaebf7f1296b3d5c6102c4b2387b8cfbabc97:$f | grep -ni 'not be mocked\|never mock\|test doubles\|fixtures it\|reproducible stand-in\|reproducible verification\|numbered manual' ; done
